lyrics:
Christmas Song: King of Glory

Verse 1
A star arose in the silent night,
Guiding the way to the holy light.
A child is born, the promised King,
Heaven rejoices, let the angels sing.

Chorus
Hail the King of Glory, born to save,
Bringing hope to the world He gave.
Lift your hearts, let the praises ring,
Jesus Christ, our Savior and King.

Verse 2
In a humble manger, love came down,
A crown of grace for a thorn-filled crown.
Peace on earth, mercy in His name,
Forevermore, His love remains.

Chorus
Hail the King of Glory, born to save,
Bringing hope to the world He gave.
Lift your hearts, let the praises ring,
Jesus Christ, our Savior and King.

Bridge
Let the nations bow, let the earth proclaim,
The wonder of His holy name.
Emmanuel, God with us,
In Him we place our trust.

Chorus
Hail the King of Glory, born to save,
Bringing hope to the world He gave.
Lift your hearts, let the praises ring,
Jesus Christ, our Savior and King.

Outro
Glory to God, His love we sing,
Forever reigning, our Savior and King.
